pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.summary: How we collect, use and protect your personal information when you shop with AURAQ.
pages.content:
AURAQ ("we", "us", "our") respects your privacy. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you visit our website or place an order, how we use it, and the choices you have.

## Information we collect

**Information you give us.** When you create an account, place an order, subscribe to our newsletter or contact customer care, we collect details such as your name, email address, phone number, shipping and billing addresses, and your order history.

**Payment information.** Card and wallet payments are processed by our payment partners. We never store full card numbers on our servers. For cash on delivery and bank transfer orders we only record the payment method and status.

**Information collected automatically.** We collect technical information such as your device type, browser, pages viewed and referring website. We use essential cookies to keep you signed in and to remember the contents of your bag.

## How we use your information

- To process, ship and support your orders, including sending order and delivery updates.
- To manage your account, wishlist, saved addresses and reviews.
- To send marketing emails when you have opted in. Every email includes an unsubscribe link.
- To prevent fraud, secure our website and comply with legal obligations.
- To understand how our website is used so we can improve it.

## Sharing your information

We share information only with partners who help us operate our business — courier companies, payment providers, email and hosting services — and only to the extent they need to perform their service. We do not sell your personal information.

## Data retention

We keep order records for as long as required for accounting and tax purposes. Account information is kept while your account is active. You can ask us to delete your account at any time.

## Your rights

You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by writing to care@auraq.pk. You can update most account details yourself from your account dashboard.

## Security

We use industry-standard encryption (HTTPS) and access controls to protect your data. Access to customer information is limited to staff who need it to fulfil orders.

## Children

Our website is not directed at children under 13 and we do not knowingly collect their information.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last revised.

## Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to care@auraq.pk or AURAQ Customer Care, 14-C MM Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan.

pages.title: Return & Exchange Policy
pages.summary: Exchanges within 14 days, store credit and how to start a return.
pages.content:
We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, we're happy to help.

## Exchange window

Ready-to-wear, luxury pret and formal pieces can be exchanged for a different size or style within **14 days** of delivery. Unstitched fabric can be exchanged within **7 days** of delivery provided it has not been cut.

## Eligibility

To be eligible, items must be:

- Unworn, unwashed and unaltered, with all original tags attached.
- Returned in the original packaging with the invoice or order number.
- Free from perfume, makeup or stains.

The following cannot be exchanged or returned:

- Items purchased on final sale or with a "Final Sale" label.
- Customised, altered or made-to-measure pieces.
- Jewellery, accessories and gift cards.

## Refunds

Exchanges are our preferred resolution. Where an exchange is not possible, we issue **store credit** valid for six months. Cash refunds are offered only for items that arrive damaged, defective or incorrect.

## Damaged or incorrect items

If your order arrives damaged or you received the wrong item, please contact us within **48 hours** of delivery with photographs of the item and packaging. We will arrange a free collection and replacement.

## How to start an exchange

1. Email care@auraq.pk or message us on WhatsApp with your order number and the items you'd like to exchange.
2. Our team will confirm eligibility and share the return address.
3. Pack the items securely with the invoice and send them back. Return shipping is the customer's responsibility unless the item was faulty.
4. Once received and inspected, your exchange or store credit is processed within 5–7 working days.

## International orders

International orders can be exchanged within 14 days of delivery. Return shipping and any duties are paid by the customer.

pages.title: Shipping Policy
pages.summary: Delivery times, charges and tracking for orders within Pakistan and worldwide.
pages.content:
## Processing time

Orders are processed within **1–2 working days**. Orders placed after 3pm, on Sundays or on public holidays are processed the next working day. During sale periods and festive launches, processing may take slightly longer.

## Delivery within Pakistan

| Method | Delivery time | Charge |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Delivery | 3–5 working days | Rs. 250, complimentary over Rs. 5,000 |
| Express Delivery | 1–2 working days (Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad) | Rs. 650 |

Delivery times for remote areas may be longer. Cash on delivery is available nationwide.

## International shipping

We ship to the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada and Australia. International orders are delivered within **7–12 working days** via tracked courier. Shipping is complimentary on orders above Rs. 60,000.

International customers are responsible for any import duties or taxes charged by their country's customs authority.

## Tracking your order

Once your order is dispatched you will receive an email with your tracking number. You can also check your order status from your account or on our Track Order page.

## Failed delivery

Our courier will attempt delivery twice. If delivery is unsuccessful, the parcel is returned to us and we will contact you to arrange re-delivery. Re-delivery charges may apply.

## Address changes

Please contact us as soon as possible if you need to change your delivery address. We can only update addresses before your order has been dispatched.

pages.title: Cancellation Policy
pages.summary: When and how an order can be cancelled.
pages.content:
## Cancelling your order

You can cancel your order free of charge **before it has been dispatched**. To cancel, email care@auraq.pk or contact customer care with your order number as soon as possible.

Once an order has been dispatched it can no longer be cancelled. You may instead request an exchange once it is delivered, in line with our Return & Exchange Policy.

## Prepaid orders

If you paid online or by bank transfer, cancelled orders are refunded to the original payment method within **7–10 working days**. Your bank may take additional time to reflect the refund.

## Cash on delivery

Repeatedly refusing cash-on-delivery parcels may result in cash on delivery being disabled for your account.

## Cancellations by AURAQ

We may cancel an order if an item is out of stock, if there is a pricing error, or if we are unable to verify the order. If this happens we will notify you immediately and refund any payment in full.

pages.content:

## Products and pricing

- We make every effort to display colours accurately; slight variations may occur due to screen settings and the handcrafted nature of our products.
- Prices and availability may change without notice. The price charged is the price shown at checkout when your order is placed.

## Orders

- We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order, for example where an item is out of stock or there is a pricing error. Any payment made will be refunded in full.

## Payment

## Discount codes

Discount codes cannot be combined unless stated, have no cash value, and may be withdrawn at any time. Each code is subject to its own terms, including minimum spend and expiry date.

## Reviews and content

By submitting a review you confirm it reflects your genuine experience and grant us the right to display it. We may moderate or remove reviews that are offensive, misleading or unrelated to the product.

To the extent permitted by law, AURAQ is not liable for indirect or consequential loss arising from the use of this website or our products.

pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
pages.summary: Answers to common questions about orders, sizing, delivery and exchanges.
pages.content:
## Orders & payment

**Which payment methods do you accept?**
Cash on delivery and bank transfer are available nationwide. Additional online payment methods are shown at checkout when available.

**Can I change my order after placing it?**
Contact us as soon as possible. We can amend orders that have not yet been dispatched.

## Sizing

**How do I choose my size?**
Each product page includes a size guide with measurements in inches. If you are between sizes, we recommend the larger size for a relaxed fit.

**Are your colours accurate?**
We photograph every piece in natural light. Slight variations can occur due to screen settings and hand-dyeing.

## Delivery

**How long does delivery take?**
Standard delivery takes 3–5 working days within Pakistan; express delivery takes 1–2 working days in major cities. International orders take 7–12 working days.

**How can I track my order?**
Use the Track Order page with your order number and email address, or sign in to view your order history.

## Exchanges

**What is your exchange policy?**
Unworn items with tags attached can be exchanged within 14 days of delivery. Please see our Return & Exchange Policy for details.
